topics.name: Snowflake Architecture & Concepts
topics.description: Understanding Snowflake's multi-cluster shared data architecture, including the separation of storage, compute, and cloud services layers.

subtopics.name: Three-Layer Architecture
subtopics.description: How Snowflake separates storage, compute (virtual warehouses), and cloud services into independently scalable layers.
keyPoints: Database storage layer holds compressed, columnar micro-partitions
Compute layer is made of independent virtual warehouses
Cloud services layer coordinates authentication, metadata, and optimization
Storage and compute scale independently
Multiple warehouses can query the same data without contention

subtopics.name: Virtual Warehouses
subtopics.description: Sizing, scaling, and managing the compute clusters that execute queries and DML.
keyPoints: Warehouse sizes scale compute power (XS to 6XL)
Auto-suspend and auto-resume control cost
Multi-cluster warehouses handle concurrency
Warehouses can be resized while running
Each warehouse has its own local SSD cache

topics.name: Data Loading & Unloading
topics.description: Loading data into Snowflake and unloading it out, using stages, the COPY command, and continuous loading with Snowpipe.

subtopics.name: Stages and the COPY Command
subtopics.description: Using internal and external stages with COPY INTO to bulk load data.
keyPoints: Internal stages: user, table, and named stages
External stages reference cloud storage (S3, Azure, GCS)
COPY INTO bulk loads files from a stage into a table
File formats define how data is parsed
Load metadata prevents reloading the same file

subtopics.name: Continuous Loading with Snowpipe
subtopics.description: Loading data continuously as it arrives using Snowpipe's serverless ingestion.
keyPoints: Snowpipe loads data in micro-batches as files land
Serverless compute billed per-second of usage
Auto-ingest uses cloud event notifications
Useful for near-real-time data pipelines
Idempotent loading avoids duplicate ingestion

topics.name: Security & Access Control
topics.description: Role-based access control, authentication, and data protection features in Snowflake.

subtopics.name: Role-Based Access Control
subtopics.description: How Snowflake grants privileges to roles and roles to users in a hierarchy.
keyPoints: Privileges are granted to roles, roles to users
System-defined roles: ACCOUNTADMIN, SYSADMIN, SECURITYADMIN, USERADMIN, PUBLIC
Role hierarchies allow privilege inheritance
Secondary roles broaden a session's active privileges
Least-privilege design is recommended

subtopics.name: Data Protection
subtopics.description: Encryption, network policies, and continuous data protection features.
keyPoints: End-to-end encryption at rest and in transit
Time Travel restores historical data within a retention period
Fail-safe provides a 7-day recovery window after Time Travel
Network policies restrict access by IP
Multi-factor authentication strengthens sign-in
